text:
## Customer Requests  
**Customer Right to Data Deletion:**  
**GDPR Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"):**
- Customer can request deletion
- FirstUK Bank may refuse if legal obligation exists
- Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)  
**Procedure:**
1. Customer requests deletion (in writing)
2. FirstUK Bank assesses legal hold
3. If no hold: Destroy and confirm
4. If hold: Explain reason and timeframe

raw_entities.name: Data Deletion and Right to Erasure Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing customer requests for data deletion under GDPR Right to Erasure. FirstUK Bank may refuse deletion where legal obligations exist, particularly under POCA and AML regulations. The policy establishes a four-step assessment and notification procedure.
context: Customer can request deletion
FirstUK Bank may refuse if legal obligation exists
Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)
If no hold: Destroy and confirm

raw_entities.name: Customer Right to Request Data Deletion
raw_entities.description: Customers have the right to request deletion of their personal data under GDPR. This provision establishes the customer's entitlement to initiate the erasure process.
context: Customer can request deletion
Customer requests deletion (in writing)

raw_entities.name: Bank Right to Refuse Deletion on Legal Grounds
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank may refuse customer deletion requests where legal obligations require data retention. This provision protects the bank's compliance obligations under financial crime and regulatory frameworks.
context: FirstUK Bank may refuse if legal obligation exists
Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)

raw_entities.name: Legal Hold Assessment Process
raw_entities.description: Upon receipt of a deletion request, FirstUK Bank must assess whether legal holds apply to the customer's data. The assessment determines whether deletion can proceed or must be refused.
context: FirstUK Bank assesses legal hold
If no hold: Destroy and confirm
If hold: Explain reason and timeframe

raw_entities.name: Deletion Request Notification and Confirmation
raw_entities.description: FirstUK Bank must confirm deletion to the customer when no legal hold exists, or explain the reason and timeframe for retention when a hold is in place.
context: If no hold: Destroy and confirm
If hold: Explain reason and timeframe

raw_entities.name: General Data Protection Regulation
raw_entities.description: EU/UK data protection regulation establishing the Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten) that forms the legal basis for this policy. GDPR permits data controllers to refuse erasure where legal obligations require retention.
context: GDPR Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten")
Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)

raw_entities.name: Proceeds of Crime Act
raw_entities.description: UK legislation establishing financial crime investigation and asset recovery obligations. POCA creates a legal hold exception preventing deletion of customer records where required for proceeds of crime investigations.
context: Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)

raw_entities.name: Anti-Money Laundering Regulations
raw_entities.description: Regulatory framework requiring financial institutions to maintain records for AML compliance purposes. AML obligations create a legal hold exception preventing deletion of customer data where regulatory record retention is mandated.
context: Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Non-Compliance Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk that premature deletion of customer data could breach POCA or AML record retention obligations, exposing FirstUK Bank to regulatory sanctions and enforcement action.
context: Exception: POCA, AML records (cannot delete if regulatory required)
If hold: Explain reason and timeframe

raw_entities.name: Legal Hold Assessment Control
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring FirstUK Bank to assess and document legal holds before processing any customer deletion request. This gate prevents inadvertent deletion of data subject to regulatory retention obligations.
context: FirstUK Bank assesses legal hold
If no hold: Destroy and confirm
If hold: Explain reason and timeframe

raw_entities.name: Data Destruction and Confirmation Process
raw_entities.description: Operational procedure requiring FirstUK Bank to destroy customer data when no legal hold exists and to provide written confirmation of destruction to the customer.
context: If no hold: Destroy and confirm

raw_entities.description: The data controller responsible for assessing deletion requests, determining legal holds, and either destroying data or explaining retention reasons to customers.

properties.name: Data Deletion and Right to Erasure Policy

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank recognizes customer right to erasure under GDPR while maintaining compliance with legal obligations under POCA and AML regulations
properties.scope_summary: Applies to customer requests for data deletion; excludes data subject to legal holds under POCA, AML, or other regulatory requirements

properties.name: Customer Right to Request Data Deletion

properties.core_requirement: Customer can request deletion of personal data

properties.name: Bank Right to Refuse Deletion on Legal Grounds

properties.core_requirement: FirstUK Bank may refuse deletion if legal obligation exists to retain data
FirstUK Bank must assess whether legal hold applies before processing deletion request
If no legal hold exists, destroy data and confirm to customer; if hold exists, explain reason and timeframe

properties.key_obligation: Organizations must honor customer right to erasure (right to be forgotten) subject to legal exceptions
Records related to proceeds of crime must be retained and cannot be deleted
AML records must be retained for regulatory compliance and cannot be deleted

properties.risk_definition: Risk that FirstUK Bank deletes data required to be retained under POCA or AML regulations, resulting in regulatory breach
properties.required_response: Assess legal hold before processing any deletion request

properties.escalation_path: If legal hold identified, notify customer of reason and timeframe

properties.evidence_required: Confirmation of destruction provided to customer

properties.context_role: Data subject with right to request erasure under GDPR

specific_obligation: Assess legal hold on deletion requests
Refuse deletion if legal obligation exists
Destroy data if no legal hold applies
Explain reason and timeframe if legal hold applies
properties.accountability_for: Compliance with GDPR right to erasure while maintaining regulatory compliance under POCA and AML
